summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors declared interest on equity (IoE) for Q2 2026, totaling R$ 200,000,000, equivalent to R$ 0.28096472120 per share. The IoE will be imputed to mandatory dividends for fiscal year 2026. Shareholders of record on B3 as of June 23, 2026, and NYSE ADS holders as of July 2, 2026, are eligible. Payment is scheduled for May 24, 2027, without adjustment or additional remuneration. The depositary bank is JPMorgan Chase. Watch for final per-share amounts after treasury share adjustments and any changes to the payment timeline.
